title: Grateful Dead Live at Glens Falls Civic Center on 1982-04-14

ai_review.summary: Matrix recording with noticeable time‑delay issues captures a strong 1982 show highlighted by a smoking Tighten Up Some and a tasty China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider transition.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its high energy, especially the smoking TLEO and an extended, flavorful China Cat Sunflower into I Know You Rider that many fans rank among the best of ’82. The matrix source provides a generally listenable mix but suffers from vocal/key timing delays and occasional hot‑spotting of keyboards, which detracts from an otherwise solid sound.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is consistently rated high (smoking TLEO, tasty Rider) while recording quality shows mixed feedback with specific timing problems; weighted average yields a strong but not perfect rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Time‑delay artifacts on Jerry's lead in TLEO, occasional hot vocals/keyboards and reduced bass typical of early‑80s matrix mixes; overall listenable but not pristine.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth transitions with a notably long, tasty bridge into Rider; the set maintains high momentum throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Raspy vocal tone noted positively; lead guitar suffers from time‑delay glitches in TLEO.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keyboards described as occasionally ‘hot’ in the matrix mix, but no specific performance comments.
